title: Ondo centred dark statement
description: A pure-black band built around a centred two-tone heading (white first line, grey second) under a small label, a long pause of empty black, then a centred serif paragraph and a pale button, followed by a tall visual area 80% of the window high. The heading, paragraph and button each fade up 40px as they enter view.
notes: media slot: the tall visual under the button (a diagram or video on the original); a faint surface when empty
forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class
the reveals are CSS scroll-driven: browsers without them show everything in place
name: ondo-nexus

props.name: media
props.description: the tall visual under the button. A faint surface when empty
